owned_invariants: Every returned object has passed Validate().
boundaries: Computes nothing; forwards to the core.

score.level_basis: Typed facade over the five methods: local JSON pre-check, deserialisation with contract errors, validation of every answer.

basis.G1: Header declares AuthorityEffect: None and a unique contract URN; the exported names (__all__ or public types) are the ones the docstring describes and the contract lists. Not B: no requirement-to-symbol trace beyond this contract.
basis.G2: Answers are deserialised and validated before return; user text that is not JSON is refused locally as Admission.
basis.G3: Typed failures: every core failure becomes CoreException with a CoreErrorKind (RULE_CS_002 checks run after deserialisation; no null-forgiving operator in runtime code, enforced by a scan); async methods take and forward CancellationToken (CA2016 as error); disposables are disposed (CA2000/CA1816 as error). Not B: panic-freedom is tested, not proven.
basis.G4: Unit tests, view-model tests with a scripted client, and contract tests against the real Python core. Mutation R = 1/1 (see mutation_accounting).
basis.G5: Cyclomatic complexity from lizard and CA1502 (threshold 10, error at build); nesting from the brace estimate. Cognitive complexity is not measured for C#, so A is not claimed. Metrics: worst function: cyclomatic 3, cognitive None, nesting 1; metrics ceiling A+.
